terms.def: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation: India’s national drug regulator, headed by the Drugs Controller General of India (DCGI).
Drugs (Prices Control) Order, 2013: sets ceiling prices and requires the MRP, inclusive of all taxes, on the label.
Maximum retail price, printed on the label inclusive of all taxes.
National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority: fixes and revises ceiling prices.
Symbols for narcotic or psychotropic Schedule H/H1 drugs (NRx) and Schedule X drugs (XRx).
The prescribing information approved by CDSCO, packed with the drug.
The generic name of the drug, printed at least two font sizes larger than the brand name.
The rule of the Drugs Rules, 1945 that lists the particulars every drug label must show.
The rule setting the cautions and warnings for Schedule G, H, H1 and X drugs, printed in a red box.
Lists of prescription drugs with increasing control; each has its own label caution and symbol.
The list of brands that must carry a QR code with set data elements.
Diseases a drug may not claim to prevent or cure.
